Title: General availability: Improved legends in IoT Central Analytics charts

Body.Content:
This IoT Central update adds the ability for you to group by Device Name so that Analytics charts are easier to read and understand.  Previously you could only group by Device ID to guarantee devices were shown separately in the chart legend.

Learn more about using IoT Central's analytics feature to analyize device data in the documentation.
